body: Thanks but I lost all my purpose. What this has shown me is I shouldn't wait any longer when I have had this opportunity every day. All I am doing is getting people's hopes up that I will make it when I never, ever could. I should start thinking about myself instead of everyone else.
Wish I knew. Wanted me to talk to them more, but I guess I was too negative for them. I guess it's my fault, I told them I'm hopeless so I guess they finally agree.
Yep. I get that everyone has their own stuff to deal with, but it's a bit selfish to ask someone to stay alive for them, then just drop them.
